versions.changelog:
Initial release of qubitclient: unified Python package for quantum calibration data analysis.

- Combines numerical curve fitting, neural network spectrum analysis, LLM-based calibration review, and real-time measurement control.
- Provides simple configuration and initialization via CLI and Python API.
- Supports multiple task categories: spectroscopy, relaxation, pulse, flux, readout, benchmarking, control, and review.
- Includes modular sub-skills: qubitclient-scope, qubitclient-nnscope, qubitclient-vqa-review, and qubitclient-control.
- Full installation and setup instructions available for all features.
